name.description: Required. For a built-in, the OpenSearch built-in name (e.g. 'standard', 'lowercase', 'html_strip', 'icu_tokenizer', 'phonetic'). For a custom component, any identifier unique within the owning TextAnalyzer.

definition.description: Optional. A JSON object string carrying the OpenSearch component definition; required when the component is not a built-in. The JSON object must include a 'type' field naming the OpenSearch component type — see e.g. edge_ngram tokenizer, stop token filter, pattern_replace char filter. AOSS NOTE: file-based parameters are not supported — any key ending in '_path' ('stopwords_path', 'synonyms_path', 'mappings_path', 'protected_words_path', 'rules_path', etc.) is rejected at create/update time. Use the inline equivalents ('stopwords', 'synonyms', 'mappings', 'protected_words').
